items.title: When Does LLM-Extracted Central Bank Sentiment Add Value? A Fragility Analysis of Sentiment-Tilted CVaR Portfolios in FX Markets
items.claim: LLM-extracted sentiment from central bank statements fails to provide statistically significant portfolio improvements.

items.title: Do Capital-Goods Incentive Announcements Move Italian Industrial Stocks? An Event Study with LLM-Coded Regulatory Acts, 2019–2026
items.claim: Italian capital-goods incentive policies produce no measurable abnormal stock returns upon announcement.

items.title: Agentic Decision Mathematics: Risk-Constrained Allocation of Operational Autonomy Under Uncertainty in Financial Market Infrastructure
items.claim: AI operational autonomy should be formalized as a constrained, optimizable resource managed through mathematics.

items.title: Computation Is Explanation: An Active Inference Agent for Interpretable Portfolio Control
items.claim: Active Inference embeds portfolio control explanations in decision computation, enabling true ante-hoc interpretability.

items.title: Which Learned Forecaster Wins, and When? A Regime-and Horizon-Conditioned Comparison of Recurrent, Attentional, Generative and Tree-Based Stock-Forecasting Models, with a Regime-Switching Mixture of Experts
items.claim: Regime-Switching Mixture of Experts beats individual forecasters without requiring ex-ante knowledge of which is best.

items.title: Delegated Consumption and the Missing Discipline of Competition An Equilibrium Theory of the AI Token Market
items.claim: Delegated AI execution lets firms control unauditable consumption intensity, neutralizing token-price competition benefits.
